```{r, echo=FALSE}

# Define 538 table theme for Reactable table(s) below
theme_538 <- function() {
    reactable::reactableTheme(
        searchInputStyle = list(width = "31%", backgroundColor = "#F9F9F9"),
        style = list(
            fontFamily = "Titillium Web"
        ),
        headerStyle = list(
            "&:hover[aria-sort]" = list(
                background = "hsl(0, 0%, 80%)"),
            "&[aria-sort='ascending'], &[aria-sort='descending']" = list(
                background = "#555",
                color = "#FFF"
            ),
            borderColor = "#333"
        ),
        borderColor = "#CDCDCD"
    )
}
```


## Games {.tabset}

### Scores & Schedule

```{r, echo=FALSE}

# Make games table
games2 <- games %>% 
  # using PFR's methodology to turn spreads into win probabilities
   mutate(home_pred = 1- (pnorm(0.5, mean = spread_line, sd = 12.7)
                    ),
          away_pred = 1-home_pred
         ) %>%
  select(game_id, game_type, gameday, week, away_team:home_score, spread_line, 
         away_pred, home_pred,away_qb_name, home_qb_name, stadium)

# Get team logos
team_logos <- nflfastR::teams_colors_logos

# Get player headshots
rosters <- nflfastR::fast_scraper_roster(seasons = 2023) %>% 
  select(full_name, headshot_url)


# join in team logos and headshots for inclusion in table
games2 <- left_join(games2, team_logos, by = c("away_team" = "team_abbr")) #Away teams
games2 <- left_join(games2, team_logos, by = c("home_team" = "team_abbr")) #Home teams

#games2 <- left_join(games2, rosters, by = c("away_qb_name" = "full_name")) #Away QBs
#games2 <- left_join(games2, rosters, by = c("home_qb_name" = "full_name")) #Home QBs


# set it up for the table
games2 <- games2 %>% 
  select(week, gameday, game_type, team_logo_espn.x, away_team, away_score, team_logo_espn.y, home_team, home_score, spread_line,  away_pred, home_pred) %>% 
  rename(team_logo_espn_away = team_logo_espn.x,
         team_logo_espn_home = team_logo_espn.y)
# %>% drop_na() #uncomment once first game has been played


# Reactable table

games_table <- reactable(
  games2,

                                       align = "center"),

                                       align = "right",
                                       minWidth = 120),

                                         style = list(borderRight = "2px solid #555"),
                                       align = "right"),

                      ),

                                       align = "right"),
                    home_score = colDef(
                      name = "Home Score",
                      style = if (all(is.na(games2$home_score))) {
                        NULL  # Don't apply color scales if all values are NA
                      } else {
                        color_scales(
                          games2,
                          colors = paletteer::paletteer_d(palette = "ggsci::amber_material")
                        )
                      },
                      align = "right"
                    ),
                      spread_line = colDef(name = "Home Spread",
                                           style = list(borderLeft = "2px solid #555"),
                                       align = "right"),
                      away_pred = colDef(name = "Away Prob",
                                         format =  colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 0),
                                       align = "right"),
                      home_pred = colDef(name = "Home Prob",
                                         format =  colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 0),
                                       align = "right"),
                      
                      ### add logos using embed_img()
                      team_logo_espn_home = colDef(
                          name = "",

                          align = "right",

                      team_logo_espn_away = colDef(
                          name = "",
```

### Game Recaps

A team-by-team box score for every game played this season, on the efficiency
metrics that actually explain results. Each game is a pair of rows, away team
first. Cells are shaded within the column: cool = good, warm = bad, so a row
that reads blue across is a team that controlled the game.

```{r Recap Data, echo = FALSE}

pbp <- load_pbp(2026)

# Run/pass plays with EPA, same filter as the League page
pbp_rp <- pbp %>%
  filter(rush == 1 | pass == 1, !is.na(epa))

current_week <- max(pbp_rp$week, na.rm = TRUE)

# Offensive and defensive EPA/play by team and game. Same definitions as the
# League page, where net EPA/play is off_epa - def_epa.
recap_off <- pbp_rp %>%
  group_by(game_id, week, team = posteam) %>%
  summarize(off_epa = mean(epa), .groups = "drop")

recap_def <- pbp_rp %>%
  group_by(game_id, team = defteam) %>%
  summarize(def_epa = mean(epa), .groups = "drop")

# Explosive plays: 20+ yards on passes, 10+ on runs (same as the Teams page).
recap_explosive <- pbp %>%
  filter(play_type %in% c("pass", "run"), penalty == 0, !is.na(epa)) %>%
  mutate(explosive_play = case_when(
    play_type == "pass" & yards_gained >= 20 ~ 1,
    play_type == "run" & yards_gained >= 10 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )) %>%
  group_by(game_id, team = posteam) %>%
  summarize(explosive_share = sum(explosive_play) / n(), .groups = "drop")

recap_turnovers <- pbp_rp %>%
  group_by(game_id, team = posteam) %>%
  summarize(
    n_turnovers = sum(interception, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(fumble_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    turnover_rate = n_turnovers / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Penalties are charged to penalty_team, which is not always posteam (defensive
# penalties happen on the other team's snaps), so this cannot come off pbp_rp.
recap_penalties <- pbp %>%
  filter(penalty == 1, !is.na(penalty_team), penalty_team != "") %>%
  group_by(game_id, team = penalty_team) %>%
  summarize(
    n_penalties = n(),
    penalty_yards = sum(penalty_yards, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

recaps <- recap_off %>%
  left_join(recap_def, by = c("game_id", "team")) %>%
  left_join(recap_explosive, by = c("game_id", "team")) %>%
  left_join(recap_turnovers, by = c("game_id", "team")) %>%
  left_join(recap_penalties, by = c("game_id", "team")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(n_turnovers, n_penalties, penalty_yards), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    epa_play = off_epa - def_epa
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    games %>% select(game_id, away_team, home_team, away_score, home_score),
    by = "game_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(home_score)) %>%
  mutate(
    score = if_else(team == home_team, home_score, away_score),
    opp_score = if_else(team == home_team, away_score, home_score),
    home_away = if_else(team == home_team, "home", "away")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    nflfastR::teams_colors_logos %>% select(team_abbr, team_logo_espn),
    by = c("team" = "team_abbr")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(week), game_id, home_away) %>% # away row sits above the home row
  select(week, team_logo_espn, team, score, opp_score, epa_play, off_epa,
         def_epa, explosive_share, n_turnovers, turnover_rate, n_penalties,
         penalty_yards)

```

```{r Recap Table, echo = FALSE}

# Diverging fills: warm pole = bad, cool pole = good, neutral grey in the middle
# (the same two arms as the Series Success chart on the Teams page). These are
# computed here rather than with reactablefmtr::color_scales() because the
# turnover and penalty columns print combined text ("2 (3.3%)", "6/39") and have
# to be shaded by a numeric column they do not display.
recap_pal <- c("#C25E45", "#E8A97E", "#F0EFEC", "#A9CBE3", "#6FB3DC")

recap_fill <- function(x, reverse = FALSE) {
  p <- (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  p[!is.finite(p)] <- 0.5
  if (reverse) p <- 1 - p
  grDevices::rgb(grDevices::colorRamp(recap_pal)(p), maxColorValue = 255)
}

recap_fills <- list(
  epa_play        = recap_fill(recaps$epa_play),
  off_epa         = recap_fill(recaps$off_epa),
  def_epa         = recap_fill(recaps$def_epa, reverse = TRUE),
  explosive_share = recap_fill(recaps$explosive_share),
  turnovers       = recap_fill(recaps$turnover_rate, reverse = TRUE),
  penalties       = recap_fill(recaps$penalty_yards, reverse = TRUE)
)

fill_style <- function(col) {
  force(col)
  function(value, index) list(background = recap_fills[[col]][index])
}

recap_table <- reactable(
  recaps,
  theme = theme_538,
  showSortIcon = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  language = reactableLang(
    searchPlaceholder = "SEARCH FOR A TEAM (ABBR)..."),
  defaultPageSize = 100,
  # keep each game's two rows visually paired
  rowStyle = function(index) {
    if (index %% 2 == 0) list(borderBottom = "2px solid #555")
  },
  columns = list(
    week = colDef(name = "Wk", align = "center", maxWidth = 55),
    team_logo_espn = colDef(
      name = "",
      maxWidth = 40,
      align = "right",
      cell = embed_img(height = "25", width = "30")
    ),
    team = colDef(name = "Team", align = "left", maxWidth = 70),
    score = colDef(
      name = "",
      maxWidth = 55,
      align = "left",
      style = list(borderRight = "2px solid #555"),
      cell = function(value, index) {
        opp <- recaps$opp_score[index]
        ink <- if (value > opp) "#1A7A1A" else if (value < opp) "#B3261E" else "#555555"
        htmltools::span(style = paste0("font-weight:700;color:", ink), value)
      }
    ),
    opp_score = colDef(show = FALSE),
    epa_play = colDef(
      name = "EPA/Play",
      align = "right",
      style = fill_style("epa_play"),
      format = colFormat(digits = 2)
    ),
    off_epa = colDef(
      name = "Off EPA/Play",
      align = "right",
      style = fill_style("off_epa"),
      format = colFormat(digits = 2)
    ),
    def_epa = colDef(
      name = "Def EPA/Play",
      align = "right",
      style = fill_style("def_epa"),
      format = colFormat(digits = 2)
    ),
    explosive_share = colDef(
      name = "Explosive Play Rate",
      align = "right",
      style = fill_style("explosive_share"),
      format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 1)
    ),
    n_turnovers = colDef(
      name = "Turnovers",
      align = "right",
      style = fill_style("turnovers"),
      cell = function(value, index) {
        sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", value, 100 * recaps$turnover_rate[index])
      }
    ),
    turnover_rate = colDef(show = FALSE),
    n_penalties = colDef(
      name = "Penalties (n/yds)",
      align = "right",
      style = fill_style("penalties"),
      cell = function(value, index) {
        paste0(value, "/", recaps$penalty_yards[index])
      }
    ),
    penalty_yards = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  pagination = FALSE,
  compact = TRUE,
  borderless = FALSE,
  striped = FALSE,
  fullWidth = FALSE,
  defaultColDef = colDef(align = "center", minWidth = 95)
) %>%
  add_title("Game Recaps",
            font_size = 28) %>%
  add_subtitle(glue("How each team performed in every game this season, through Week {current_week}. Cool cells are good, warm cells are bad, shaded within each column. Click a column header to sort by that statistic."),
               font_size = 14,
               font_weight = "normal") %>%
  add_source("Data: nflfastR")

recap_table

```
